headline: Gutter Becomes Chief Battleground as Three Fronts Still Firing
war_summary: The war's heaviest fighting has shifted to the Gutter, where thirteen actions were logged in the past two hours — the latest at this hour — and where Colonial forces hold six works to one Warden. Casualties there run near ninety-eight Colonial and sixty-one Warden an hour, both easing slightly but still brisk. Marban Hollow, ablaze a few hours ago, has quieted to a single action in two hours about Oster Wall. The Nevish Line keeps firing, two actions in the same span and hourly losses of roughly 443 Colonial and 359 Warden, both rising. Palantine Berm saw four actions in two hours, its seven works split three Colonial, two Warden and two unclaimed. Linn Mercy holds eleven works, eight Colonial, two Warden and one unclaimed, after two fresh actions. Weathered Expanse returned to the lists with six actions near Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest, its nine works four Warden, three Colonial and two unclaimed. Godcrofts, busiest of yesterday, has not fired since early afternoon; its nine works remain Colonial. The victory mark stands at thirty-four towns.
